dg-APL-254352.title: AquaReady Frozen Fish Food Strainer
dg-APL-254352.summary: A small AquaReady strainer for draining the thaw liquid off frozen foods before feeding, so less phosphate and nitrate goes into the tank.
rows: Laser-cut, a bit larger than baby mysis shrimp
Medium to large chunk frozen foods
Separates food from thaw liquid (phosphates, nitrates, binders)

dg-APL-254967.title: Maxspect Frozen Foods Mold
dg-APL-254967.summary: A flexible silicone Maxspect mold for freezing your own fish and coral food into small cubes, with a cover and feeding tweezers.
rows: DIY frozen food for fish and corals
